notApplicable.size: The chart has explicit width/height domain geometry and no control-size prop; provider size does not rescale chart coordinates.
notApplicable.disabled: The chart does not expose a disabled prop. Hidden series are real selected/unselected legend states.
notApplicable.error: Loading and transport errors are owned by the data source. BarChart accepts complete synchronous data; refresh preserves existing chart data.
notApplicable.loading: Finite data transitions are captured naturally in a dedicated video scenario, never frozen or replaced by a loading style.
notApplicable.expanded: The chart has no disclosure or popup protocol.
